subject.title: Skill-draft semantic dedup: duplicate drafts with different hash suffixes

question: What duplicate-draft novelty contract should Skill Workshop use before creating a pending proposal?
rationale: Current behavior allows volatile proposal identities, while semantic similarity, duplicate counters, or normalized fingerprints would each create different product and persistence semantics.

options.title: Normalized Fingerprint First
options.body: Deduplicate recent pending proposals by skillKey plus normalized proposal body and only consider embeddings after that simpler contract proves insufficient.

options.title: Semantic Similarity And Counter
options.body: Add embedding-based similarity and coalesced duplicate counts, accepting the extra provider, threshold, and metadata policy surface.

options.title: Manual Review Only
options.body: Keep proposal creation permissive and rely on reviewer rejection or quarantine for duplicate drafts.

recommendation.title: Normalized Fingerprint First
recommendation.body: Deduplicate recent pending proposals by skillKey plus normalized proposal body and only consider embeddings after that simpler contract proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Skill Workshop/Skill Research proposal service and are the strongest history signal for the current novelty boundary.
